source_text: This universalist approach prioritizes individual rights over cultural relativism, critiqued by some as overlooking variations in procedure severity—such as Type I cuttings in Bohra contexts, which involve clitoral hood removal without broader excision—and potential community benefits claimed in religious or purity rituals.
